topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 103 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 13 ERC20 tokens, 5 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 7 common project-authored base contract(s) (whitelist, proxy, erc165). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
